plugins.name: aud
plugins.description: Primary AUD v2 entry point for coordinated audits, synthesis, verification, and calibration-gated reliability measurement.

plugins.name: visual-audit
plugins.description: Run an isolated visual-quality audit and rank findings by visual impact.

plugins.name: functional-audit
plugins.description: Verify functional behavior and accepted flow/remediation contracts in a real browser without redesigning specialist decisions.

plugins.name: place-audit
plugins.description: Audit approved information placement against declared tasks using demand, prominence, access cost, and ranked relocation flags.

plugins.name: content-audit
plugins.description: Audit what information deserves to exist and when: semantic duplication, view overlap, content priority, role separation, and progressive disclosure before placement/design.

plugins.name: flow-audit
plugins.description: Audit intent-to-goal journeys for unnecessary steps, weak branches, context loss, reversibility, representation-switching cost, and completion confidence before first-principles design.

plugins.name: architecture-maintainability-audit
plugins.description: Audit dependency direction, module ownership, coupling, change amplification, and structural verification seams from repository evidence.
